name: ecommerce-skills
description: Research-based advice on pricing, discounts, checkout, and product pages for online stores. Rules cite the peer-reviewed studies behind them by DOI, with uncited practitioner tips marked as such.

interface.longDescription: Gives research-based advice on pricing, discounts, checkout, and product pages for people who run an online store. It contains nineteen skills. Four work from a goal (conversion, order value, repeat purchases, raising prices), twelve from a task (pricing, discounts, promotions, price research, product pages, checkout, product copy, product visuals, store audits, post-purchase, reviews, referrals), and three from what you sell (digital products, subscriptions, events). Most rules cite a peer-reviewed study by DOI and give the condition it applies under. Where the study reports an effect size, the rule gives it. Rules without a primary paper are marked as practitioner tips. Effect sizes are what the study measured in its own context, not a forecast for your store.
defaultPrompt: Audit my product page and rank what would lift conversion.
We sell a $90 item and want to take $30 off. How should we show the discount?
Should this price end in .99 or .00?
